description: BFLA occurs when API does not check if user is authorized to perform requested function (e.g., admin function with low-privilege user).

testing: Auth as low-privilege user, try to access admin endpoints: /api/admin/users, /api/admin/settings — should be 403, if 200 then BFLA
Try different HTTP methods with low-privilege
methodology.evidence: Request as low-privilege to admin endpoint returns 200 with admin data, tool output
methodology.verification: Reproduce with low-privilege and admin accounts, confirm low-privilege can access admin function

remediation: Check authorization for every function, deny by default, role-based access control
